title.narrative: Camco - Support to REPP 2 TA Facility

description.narrative:
Norad will co-finance Camco's technical assistance facility (TAF) which will support potential investee companies for their REPP 2 investment fund. This will include project development work and competency building inside the companies, as well as proof-of-concept grants to women-led start-ups and some institutional capacity building with relevant regulatory authorities.
Through its investments, REPP 2 aims to stimulate the development of a vibrant, networked and viable market for small to medium distributed renewable energy projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, contributing to the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly SDG 7 – affordable and clean energy and SDG 13 – climate action and to the UK’s ICF strategy KPI15.
